dossier.headline: Ola Electric's Q2 revenue falls 39%; shares slide
dossier.summary: Ola Electric reported a Q2 FY27 loss of ₹362 crore on November 12, narrower than a year earlier but wider than Q1's ₹336 crore, as revenue fell 39% to ₹421 crore. Revenue and loss both came in worse than Kotak's estimates of ₹507 crore and ₹315.3 crore, and the shares fell over 4% at Friday's open.
why_it_matters: Revenue fell sharply year on year even as the loss narrowed
The stock had rallied ahead of the results
watch: Whether the post-results selling extends through the session
